consent.title: This app works with your parent's permission
consent.subtitle: Before you start using the app, your parent must agree to the following terms.
consent.locationText: The app shows the parent the child's current location and movement history — even when the app is closed or running in the background.
consent.usageText: Tracks how much time is spent in each app and reports it to the parent.
consent.notificationsText: Receives messages, reminders and SOS push notifications sent by the parent.
consent.securityText: The child's device information (battery, model) is sent to the parent.
consent.privacyText: Data is stored encrypted and is not shared with third parties.

a11yDisclosure.title: Fast blocking service
a11yDisclosure.subtitle: An extra permission is needed so a blocked app closes instantly. This is optional.
a11yDisclosure.doesText: When you open an app your parent blocked, Parvoz closes it immediately and shows why. Without it, blocking is delayed by 1-3 seconds.
a11yDisclosure.notCollectText: The service only sees which app is open. On-screen text, passwords, messages and personal data are never read or collected.
a11yDisclosure.optionalText: The app works fully without it. You can turn it off any time in your phone settings.

locationDisclosure.title: Background location
locationDisclosure.subtitle: An extra permission is needed so your parent can see your location at all times.
locationDisclosure.doesText: The child's location is tracked — even when Parvoz is closed or the phone screen is off — and the parent is notified immediately when entering/leaving a safe zone (home, school).
locationDisclosure.alwaysOnText: Location data is regularly sent to the server even while the app runs in the background — this is required for the SOS button and safe zones to work correctly.
locationDisclosure.privacyText: Location is sent only to the parent account linked to this device. It is not used for advertising and is not sold to third parties.
